picks.title: a16z creates a $1.1B 'Machine Age' fund to 'accelerate the physical buildout of AI'
picks.why_it_matters: A major VC's billion-dollar bet on AI hardware signals a strategic shift from software to infrastructure, opening opportunities for early-stage startups in chips, cooling, and data center tech.

picks.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
picks.why_it_matters: A major developer tools acquisition by SpaceX validates the AI-assisted coding category and may create market gaps as platform dynamics shift, presenting entry points for competing startups.

picks.title: GLM-5.3 is now open-weight
picks.why_it_matters: New open-weight foundation models lower barriers for AI startups to build differentiated applications without dependency on closed APIs, reducing compute costs and enabling novel use cases.
